regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate 60–86% yield/85–92% ee claim were reviewed. The ESI footnote states availability but source_mapping.json leaves association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and quantified prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Prior asymmetric allene chemistry was classified as cited literature rather than current experiments. The specifically quantified Hiroi 96% ee result is a literature record, and the current authors' explicit inability to reproduce it is retained separately as a partial failed result without copying the cited 96% ee into the current measurement.

regions.region: page 1 right-column Table 1 reaction drawing, ligand structures, rows 1–8, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Eight catalyst/ligand optimization experiments were retained row-by-row with ligand loading, palladium source/loading, temperature, time, iodobenzene and solvent overrides, NMR product yield/ee, and starting-material recovery. Entry 3 has no reported ee and remains missing.

unresolved: Most cited prior-work summaries are aggregate context and were not expanded into external-paper experiments.
The failed reproduction lacks all operating details and a measured current-paper outcome.
Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses; complex ligand/product structures remain unverified.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left continuation of Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: Narrative observations for Table 1 entries 1–8 were linked to the existing row records; no duplicate experiments were created.

regions.region: page 2 center-left Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1–7, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Seven base/solvent optimization rows were retained separately with quantities, 90 °C, row times, NMR yields/ee, recoveries, and measurement basis.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 reaction drawing, rows 1–9, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Nine mixed-solvent/additive experiments were retained separately. Entries 1–4 have no molecular sieves; entries 5–8 contain 80 mg 4 Å sieves and entry 9 contains 80 mg 3 Å sieves. Exact printed volume ratios, times, NMR yields/ee, and recoveries were preserved.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 4 reaction drawing, rows 1–9, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Nine aryl-iodide scope experiments were retained row-by-row with time, concentration, isolated yield, ee, shared catalyst/base/sieve/solvent conditions, the 1.2-equiv diiodobenzene override, and the 0.5 mmol entry-9 scale.

regions.region: page 2 bottom scope prose introducing Table 5
regions.finding: The gamma-allenol substitution discussion maps to the three Table 5 rows printed on page 3; no page-2-only duplicate record was created.

unresolved: Optimization tables omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Table 4 does not print total solvent volumes or ee measurement methods; compact product structures remain machine candidates.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 5 reaction drawing, rows 1–3, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Three substituted gamma-allenol scope experiments were retained separately with R1/R2/R3 patterns, 0.5 mmol scale, iodobenzene quantity, catalyst/base/sieve conditions, time, concentration, isolated yield, and ee.

regions.region: page 3 left-center Scheme 1 and adjacent sentence
regions.finding: A distinct one-gram-scale 1a/4-bromo-4'-iodobiphenyl experiment was retained with Pd(dba)2/(R,R)-L1/K3PO4/mixed nitrile solvent/3 Å sieves, 90 °C, 44 h, 85% yield, and 90% ee. No exact gram mass was invented.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 2 and configuration-assignment prose
regions.finding: The two-stage preparation of authentic (S)-2a via phenyl ketone formation and in-situ Wittig methenylation was retained as one partial multistep experiment; it supported retention-time/specific-rotation assignment of 2a as R, but no missing yields or conditions were inferred.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 3 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: The PhPdI carbopalladation/syn-B versus syn-C/intramolecular hydroxyl-attack cycle is explicitly proposed and classified as mechanism rather than observed preparative experiments.

regions.region: page 3 acknowledgements and Notes and references
regions.finding: The authors thank Qiankun Li for reproducing preparations of 2d, 2i, and 2k. These statements were linked to Table 4 entries 4 and 9 and Table 5 entry 2; no duplicate runs were created because no independent conditions or outcomes are supplied. Remaining text is bibliography.

unresolved: Table 5 and Scheme 1 omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and analytical methods.
Scheme 2 omits all quantities, temperatures, times, workups, and yields.
Scheme 3 intermediates are proposed rather than isolated; compact structures and stereochemistry remain unverified.
Reproduction acknowledgements contain no separate run data; SI association remains unestablished.
